subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar officially support this persistent local external-command hook API and commit to the documented v1 config, event, and payload compatibility contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically credible and owner-hardened, but accepting a durable automation API and local command-execution surface is a product and compatibility commitment that tests cannot decide.

options.title: Adopt the v1 contract
options.body: Approve the documented opt-in event set and security model, then merge once required checks finish on the exact head.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Reduce the initial event or UI and CLI surface and explicitly document which contract elements remain experimental before merging.

options.title: Do not add command hooks
options.body: Close the implementation and keep CodexBar limited to observability and existing notification or export surfaces.

recommendation.title: Adopt the v1 contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented opt-in event set and security model, then merge once required checks finish on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner directly authored the latest four hardening commits and is best positioned to accept the permanent product and compatibility contract.
